source: Definitional arithmetic: the Rule of 72 is 72 divided by the rate. 72/6 = 12, 72/8 = 9, 72/3 = 24. The exact doubling times (ln2/ln(1+r): 11.90, 9.01, 23.45 years) are asserted separately in finance_test.dart so the approximation is never mistaken for the exact figure.

cases.note: 6% doubles in 12 years by the rule
8% doubles in 9 years by the rule
3% doubles in 24 years by the rule
